supplier_payment_allocations_one_source_.name: supplier_payment_allocations_one_source_chk
supplier_payment_allocations_one_source_.value: (supplier_payment_id IS NOT NULL) <> (supplier_credit_note_id IS NOT NULL)

customer_refunds_origin_chk.name: customer_refunds_origin_chk
customer_refunds_origin_chk.value: (origin = 'deposit' AND payment_id IS NOT NULL AND credit_note_id IS NULL) OR (origin = 'credit_note' AND credit_note_id IS NOT NULL AND payment_id IS NULL)

payment_allocations_one_source_chk.name: payment_allocations_one_source_chk
payment_allocations_one_source_chk.value: (payment_id IS NOT NULL) <> (credit_note_id IS NOT NULL)

payment_classifications_vat_category_chk.name: payment_classifications_vat_category_chk
payment_classifications_vat_category_chk.value: vat_category IS NULL OR vat_category IN ('S', 'Z', 'E')

payments_party_chk.name: payments_party_chk
payments_party_chk.value: (party_type = 'customer' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL) OR (party_type = 'none' AND customer_id IS NULL)

invoice_prepayments_split_chk.name: invoice_prepayments_split_chk
invoice_prepayments_split_chk.value: amount = taxable_amount + tax_amount AND taxable_amount >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0

statement_matches_one_target_chk.name: statement_matches_one_target_chk
statement_matches_one_target_chk.value: (payment_id IS NOT NULL) <> (refund_id IS NOT NULL)

statement_matches_manual_reason_chk.name: statement_matches_manual_reason_chk
statement_matches_manual_reason_chk.value: method <> 'manual' OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) > 0)

migration_advances_invoiced_chk.name: migration_advances_invoiced_chk
migration_advances_invoiced_chk.value: vat_position <> 'invoiced' OR advance_invoice_number IS NOT NULL

migration_assets_money_chk.name: migration_assets_money_chk
migration_assets_money_chk.value: cost >= 0 AND residual_value >= 0 AND residual_value <= cost AND opening_accumulated_depreciation >= 0 AND opening_accumulated_depreciation <= cost - residual_value

migration_assets_life_chk.name: migration_assets_life_chk
migration_assets_life_chk.value: useful_life_months > 0 AND opening_periods_booked >= 0 AND opening_periods_booked <= useful_life_months

migration_assets_vat_chk.name: migration_assets_vat_chk
migration_assets_vat_chk.value: (vat_input_tax_amount IS NULL OR vat_input_tax_amount >= 0) AND (vat_initial_recovery_pct IS NULL OR vat_initial_recovery_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

migration_chart_rows_decision_chk.name: migration_chart_rows_decision_chk
migration_chart_rows_decision_chk.value: decision IS NULL OR decision IN ('map_to_system', 'map_to_bank', 'create', 'merge_into', 'skip')

migration_open_items_einvoicing_status_c.name: migration_open_items_einvoicing_status_chk
migration_open_items_einvoicing_status_c.value: einvoicing_status IS NULL OR einvoicing_status IN ('cleared', 'reported', 'pre_einvoicing')

migration_open_items_identity_ar_only_ch.name: migration_open_items_identity_ar_only_chk
migration_open_items_identity_ar_only_ch.value: item_type = 'ar' OR (source_uuid IS NULL AND einvoicing_status IS NULL)

migration_open_items_identity_uuid_chk.name: migration_open_items_identity_uuid_chk
migration_open_items_identity_uuid_chk.value: einvoicing_status IS NULL OR einvoicing_status = 'pre_einvoicing' OR source_uuid IS NOT NULL
